title: Sikorsky and DARPA say an autonomous Black Hawk flew logistics and rescue missions without pilots aboard
summary: The Lockheed Martin unit reported an 83-mile medical resupply flight and a cargo and casualty-evacuation mission during Army-hosted Project Convergence 2022.

title: Programmers file class-action suit against Microsoft, GitHub and OpenAI over Copilot training on open-source code
summary: The suit argues that training a code-generating model on public code infringes licences.

title: TechCrunch reports Twitter laid off its entire ML Ethics, Transparency and Accountability team
summary: Twitter's machine-learning ethics team was among the groups cut in the company's layoffs.

title: Reuters reports Nvidia is offering a China-market A800 chip designed to meet new US export controls
summary: Reuters reported that the A800, an alternative to the A100 for Chinese customers, was already listed by some Chinese retailers.

title: Japan's government backs Rapidus, a new chipmaker formed by eight companies to mass-produce 2nm-class logic chips, with a JPY 70 billion subsidy
summary: EE Times Japan reports the industry ministry selected Rapidus for next-generation semiconductor development with a target of production in the late 2020s.

title: Washington Post reports tech layoffs at Meta, Twitter and others include AI and machine-learning teams
summary: Reporting on the layoff wave noted that some cuts hit AI and machine-learning staff.

title: Cerebras unveils Andromeda, an AI supercomputer with 13.5 million cores, Reuters reports
summary: The chip startup unveiled a supercomputer that the State of AI newsletter says shows near-linear scaling for large language models.

title: Defense-technology company Anduril raises USD 1.48bn in a Series E at an USD 8.48bn valuation
summary: Valor Equity Partners led the round; only the month is stated in the source.
srcName: State of AI newsletter (Air Street Capital)

title: Fortune reports FTX's collapse unsettles AI safety research; a leaked balance sheet showed USD 500M invested in Anthropic
summary: Fortune reported the FTX collapse was unsettling the AI safety research community; Bloomberg, via the newsletter, reported over USD 530M invested in AI-related firms.

title: Generate Biomedicines and the Baker Lab release generative systems for designing proteins with specified functions
summary: Baker Lab lab-tested hundreds of designs, including insulin binders; only the month is stated in the source.
srcName: State of AI newsletter (Air Street Capital)

title: Insilico Medicine signs a deal with Sanofi worth up to USD 1.2bn across six target campaigns
summary: The agreement carries up to USD 1.2bn in potential payouts; only the month is stated in the source.
srcName: State of AI newsletter (Air Street Capital)

title: Intel introduces FakeCatcher, a real-time deepfake detector it says identifies 96 percent of fake videos
summary: The tool analyses blood-flow signals in faces; Intel's figure is its own claim and the exact date is not stated in the source.

title: Nvidia and Microsoft announce a collaboration to build a large AI cloud supercomputer with tens of thousands of GPUs
summary: The partners said the system would use tens of thousands of H100 and A100 GPUs; only the month is stated in the source.
srcName: State of AI newsletter (Air Street Capital)

title: ForkLog reports Nvidia has fully ended its business operations in Russia, citing USD 16M in restructuring costs
summary: ForkLog reported that Nvidia completed its exit from Russia, where it said the market had accounted for no more than 2% of revenue, with operations ending from 30 October 2022.

title: Caltech researchers report a brain-computer interface that decodes eight internally spoken words with 91% accuracy
summary: ForkLog reported that a Caltech neural interface recognised words a participant spoke silently in their head, reaching 91% accuracy on an eight-word set.

title: Stanford CRFM releases HELM, a benchmark that evaluates language models across many scenarios and metrics
summary: HELM compares language models on a shared set of scenarios; only the month is stated in the source.
srcName: State of AI newsletter (Air Street Capital)

title: MIT Technology Review reports Meta's Galactica science-model demo stayed online for only three days
summary: Meta withdrew the public demo of its Galactica language model after three days, according to MIT Technology Review.

title: Electrek reports Tesla ordered next-generation self-driving chips from TSMC on a 4 or 5 nm process, to be made in Arizona
summary: ForkLog, citing Electrek, reported that TSMC will produce Tesla's next-generation FSD computer chips at its Arizona plant.

title: India takes over the chair of the Global Partnership on Artificial Intelligence (GPAI) at the summit in Tokyo
summary: India assumes the rotating chair of the 29-member multilateral AI initiative from France.

title: Meta AI publishes Cicero, an agent that plays the negotiation game Diplomacy at human level
summary: Meta says Cicero ranked in the top 10 percent of players across 40 online games in an 82-person league.

title: ProPublica reports the US Justice Department opened an investigation into RealPage's rent-pricing software
summary: ProPublica reported the DOJ probe into an algorithm that allegedly pushed rent prices up.

title: Baidu says its Apollo Go robotaxis average over 15 rides a day per car, near regular taxis, and calls US chip curbs' impact minor
summary: ForkLog, citing CNBC, reported Baidu CEO Robin Li said Apollo Go robotaxis in Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou averaged more than 15 daily rides per vehicle in Q3 2022.

title: Stability AI releases Stable Diffusion 2.0 with native 768x768 generation, drawing criticism over training-data filtering
summary: Version 2.0 added negative prompts and depth maps; critics pointed to distorted human figures.

title: Elon Musk says Tesla's Full Self-Driving beta is now open to any North American buyer who requests it
summary: ForkLog reported that Tesla opened its FSD beta driver-assistance software to all requesting owners in the USA and Canada, per a Musk post on 24 November 2022.

title: Sber presents Kandinsky 2.0, a multilingual text-to-image diffusion model, at its AI Journey conference
summary: AdIndex reports Sber's new image generator accepts prompts in about 100 languages.

title: OpenAI releases ChatGPT, a conversational model trained with human feedback, as a free research preview
summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT, a chatbot built on GPT-3.5 and trained with reinforcement learning from human feedback.
